title: TransitionReceipt
description:
The durable record of one committed transition.

A receipt that exists satisfies the checks of [`TransitionReceipt::new`], which
deserialization applies too. Its serde form is [`TransitionReceiptFields`].

action.description: The FORMAL §3 action the transition refines.

after.description: The aggregate's counters after the commit.

after_digests.description: The aggregate's state digests after the commit.

aggregate_uid.description: The UID of the aggregate the transition committed on.

before.description:
The aggregate's counters before the commit; the lane's revision is the command's
expected revision.

before_digests.description: The aggregate's state digests before the commit.

command_uid.description: The UID of the command that the transition decided.

disabled_guards.description:
The guards disabled when the transition was decided, in FORMAL §5 table order; empty
for every transition decided under [`Guards::all`](super::Guards::all).

effect_intents.description:
The effect intents of a domain commit, in effect-index order; empty for a control
commit.

input_digest.description: The digest of the command's input.

principal.description: The authenticated writer of the command.

reducer_version.description: The version of the reducer that decided the transition.

Counters.description: The three per-aggregate counters of KERNEL §1 at one point.

GuardId.description:
One guard of `docs/design/AUTOBOT-FORMAL-SURFACE.md` §5, one variant per row of its
negative-variant table, in table order.

Serde and the JSON schema use the variant name in kebab case.

oneOf.description: Acceptance reads the registers and records the acceptance in one CAS on one object.
`QuiescePlan` and `ResumePlanRevision` each advance `plan_generation`.

A Manager takeover is a sequence of CASes, and `ResumeManager` follows
`AdvanceManagerEpoch`.
A send is preceded by its `send_attempt` marker.
`RecordSendAttempt` writes 2a before 2b.
A control commit writes control fields only.
A pending slot is cleared only after its receipt and audit event are verified.
A projection applies events in commit-sequence order.
A continuation keeps its execution identity.
A workspace retires on a completion marker only after restore verification.
A restored installation dispatches only after a witness receipt.
A scope check compares the canonical path, not the requested string.
A telemetry gap is created at `record_deadline`.
A reviewer's identity differs from the worker session's.
A `correlated` review never satisfies the required review of `COMPATIBILITY_RISK` work.
A required security review comes only from a configuration in `securityReviewers`.
Admission compares the routing pin's tier with the floor.
Plan acceptance pins a charter revision.
A project entry never weakens an inherited law.
A continuation after a tightened law gets a fresh capsule.
Only a human principal accepts a charter revision.
A `judged` "complies" never satisfies the `review` backstop.
No accept is admitted from the intake-submitter identity.
An `Intake` reaches `PROPOSED` only with every repository forge-verified.
The domain lane: precondition `state_revision`, installs the pending commit.
The control lane: precondition `control_revision`, appends a control receipt.

ProviderBinding.description:
The `[provider, operation]` pair of an effect intent: the key of the provider capability
that carries out the effect (FORMAL §2 `EffectIntentRecord`, KERNEL §3.3).

operation.description: The provider operation that applies it.

provider.description: The provider that applies the effect.

SlotEffectIntent.description:
One effect intent as a pending commit holds it.

It holds the fields of the FORMAL §2 `EffectIntent` record that the commit decides. The
rest follow from it: `aggregate_uid` is the UID of the aggregate whose slot holds the
intent, `committed_revision` is the slot's `proposed_revision`, `uid` and `operation_key`
are derived from those and the fields here, and `state` belongs to the `EffectIntent`
object materialized from it.

contract_revision.description: The revision of the provider contract the intent is written against.

desired_outcome.description: The outcome the effect is to produce.

effect_index.description: The position of the intent among the commit's intents.

installation_lineage.description: The installation lineage the intent's operation key binds.

payload_digest.description: The digest of the intent's payload.

provider_binding.description: The provider and operation that are to carry out the effect.

target_identity.description: The identity of the effect's target at the provider.

StateDigests.description: The domain and control digests of an aggregate's state at one point (KERNEL §1).

control.description: The digest of the control fields.

domain.description: The digest of the domain fields.
